description: This file defines the interface for a System Audio Player component within the WPEFramework, including methods for controlling audio playback, configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: ISystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Interface for controlling system audio playback, configuration, and notifications.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the SAP plugin with the provided service interface.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for SAP events.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an audio player instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Starts playback of Base64 encoded audio buffer.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets mixer levels for the audio.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if the audio player is currently playing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Sets configuration for the audio player.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID of the audio player.
